data.title: Arknights: Endfield Game Tools Updated
data.brief: Dear Endministrators,Arknights: Endfield Game Tools have been updated during the [Dreamscape of Wind
data.data:
Dear Endministrators,

Arknights: Endfield Game Tools have been updated during the [Dreamscape of Wind and Snow] version. Check out what's been changed!


Map Tools Update: New Area, Position Markers, and Feature Optimizations!

Map Tools has been updated to include a feedback portal, improved browsing experiences, feature optimizations, and the new area and its position markers.

Additionally, the route feature helps you collect Aurylenes, storage crates, and resources in one go! Come try it out!

Map Tools Update Notes: https://www.skport.com/article?id=2095718779131668729

>>Go to Map Tools<<


Progression Calculator Update: Now available on PC

The Progression Calculator is now available on PC. Come try it out!

The Progression Calculator is now available on PC. A "Save image" feature has been added at the bottom of the materials interface, so you can take your calculation results with you anytime! Come try it out!

Additionally, a new in-game entry point has been added: Launch Arknights: Endfield and open the [Protosync], then click the [Game Tools] icon to access the tools page.

>>Go to the Progression Calculator<<


Widget Update: Added a guide portal and feedback survey.

Open the SKPORT app, then go to the Arknights: Endfield section. Tap the [Widget] icon at the top to access the guide post.

If you have any feedback for the Widgets, feel free to fill out and submit the survey found in the post.

>>Go to the Widget Guide Post<<


Team Picks & Build Guide Update: New Operator [Typhoeus] Now Available!

The [Team Picks] and [Build Guide] tool pages have been updated with the new operator [Typhoeus]! You can easily browse recommended team compositions and builds shared by other Endmins, or submit your own team setups and build strategies to share unique insights with fellow players.

>>Go to Team Picks & Build Guide<<


WIKI Update: Vietnamese Added

The WIKI now supports Vietnamese! On PC, use the language selector in the upper-right corner to switch to Vietnamese and view content in Vietnamese.

In addition, as the game continues to receive updates, the WIKI will be adding information on the new operator [Purrchena], new weapon [Umbra of Frigid Eventide] and more. Additional guide content will also be coming soon!

>>Go to WIKI<<


That covers all the tool updates for this version! We hope these enhancements provide even more support for your journey, Endministrators.

We welcome all Endministrators to use our Game Tools and provide valuable feedback. We will continue to improve the functionality and user experience of each tool. Thank you for your continued support!
